02 / How it works

AI interprets. Rules decide.

GenLayer helps validators read and compare web evidence. ProofCheck records a reviewable snapshot — without pretending to know absolute truth.

Read the method →
01

Submit a claim

Choose a claim type, write the statement, and attach a GitHub repo.

02

Check the evidence

Validators read the sources, compare them with the claim, and save a timestamped hash.

03

Challenge when needed

Submit a conflicting link to create a new review without deleting the old history.

03 / Start a proof check

Which repo needs a clearer record?

Enter a GitHub URL to start a verification draft. This is the first step — not a final verdict.

ProofCheck — evidence, not certainty.A public record for public claims.
